sources.title: The Jummoo and Kashmir territories: a geographical account
sources.author: Frederic Drew
sources.origin: National Library of India / Ministry of Culture
sources.finding: Original illustration index contains no palace/Jammu architectural plate. Written Mandi/court/arcade description establishes general context; no new body dimensions or georeferenced annex boundaries. No image downloaded.

sources.title: The Northern Barrier of India
sources.author: Frederic Drew
sources.finding: Original illustration index has no Jammu palace plate. Written public square/arcaded offices and court descriptions contain no missing eastern-body dimensions. A festival platform at the parade-ground is not evidence of the separately reported central marble dais. No image downloaded.
